digest.component_or_area: store git operations and local contention handling
propositions: Local git call sites across rebar are unbounded; concurrent agent storms contend on .git/index.lock, ref locks, and config locks with no automatic absorption policy, causing transient failures to surface as errors to calling agents instead of being handled silently

Operator-ratified blocking policy is bounded jittered retry with per-store advisory lock serialization (no block-forever, no fail-fast): transient lock conflicts self-heal silently at debug/warning level; only exhausted budgets surface one actionable error naming the lock file and holder guidance

All local git index-mutating call sites route through _with_index_lock_retry seam which now holds per-store advisory flock (rebar-git-op.lock), retries with jittered exponential backoff to ~20s budget, and augments exhaustion stderr with lock path and remedy guidance
Uncontended writes add zero latency: happy-path advisory lock acquisition is non-blocking flock; kernel releases lock on process death; no staleness reclamation logic required

Each local-only git call site is explicitly bounded with watchdog timeout (120s for txn/compact/delete; 120s for fsck reads; 300s for metrics; 30s for event_append) or documented as deliberately unbounded with justification
Blocking policy is stated as: bounded jittered retry + advisory serialization; silent transient recovery; one actionable error only on stuck lock (exhausted budget)
